request.style: English, male baritone solo with backing choir, electric guitar, acoustic guitar, bass, drums, 110 BPM, tense and urgent rock mood
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The flood swept them away without a sound
They knew nothing of what was coming around
So it will be when the Son of Man arrives
Taking one and leaving the other alive

[Pre-Chorus]
Do you know the day that your Lord appears?
Or the hour of night that no one hears?
If the owner knew the thief would come
He would keep watch to guard the home

[Chorus]
So stay awake because the time is near
Be ready for the moment that you fear
The Son of Man comes at an unexpected hour
Keep your eyes open, stay in power

[Verse]
Two men in the field, one is taken
Two women at the mill, one is shaken
Blessed is the servant who stays faithful
Giving food at the proper time, never hateful

[Chorus]
So stay awake because the time is near
Be ready for the moment that you fear
The Son of Man comes at an unexpected hour
Keep your eyes open, stay in power

[Bridge]
He will put him in charge of all his goods
When the master returns, the servant stands proud
Faithful and wise in the charge he holds
Till the story ends and the truth unfolds

[Outro]
Stay awake and be ready now
The night is dark but the light is how
